title: Knowledge check: How Solidity Compilation Works

questions.prompt: Which statement best demonstrates understanding of How Solidity Compilation Works?
options: It removes the need to check compiler output or runtime behavior.
It means how solidity compilation works should be understood through its role in Solidity behavior, with assumptions and limits made explicit.
It should be used without testing because the EVM is deterministic.
It guarantees that every contract using the concept is secure.
questions.answer_key: It means how solidity compilation works should be understood through its role in Solidity behavior, with assumptions and limits made explicit.
questions.explanation: The lesson treats How Solidity Compilation Works as a technical concept whose meaning depends on execution context and explicit assumptions. It does not guarantee security or replace testing.

questions.prompt: What is the best practice when applying How Solidity Compilation Works in a new contract?
options: Skip negative tests once one happy-path call succeeds.
Rely only on comments instead of checking behavior.
Start on mainnet so gas reports reflect real funds.
Build a minimal example about How Solidity Compilation Works, predict its outcome, and verify normal and edge cases in a controlled local environment.
questions.answer_key: Build a minimal example about How Solidity Compilation Works, predict its outcome, and verify normal and edge cases in a controlled local environment.
questions.explanation: Small, repeatable local tests make assumptions visible while avoiding unnecessary exposure. Failure cases are important because success-only tests leave many requirements unchecked.

questions.prompt: Before relying on How Solidity Compilation Works in a release, what should a reviewer do?
options: Check the versioned official guidance, inspect compiler/test evidence, and document limitations before relying on the behavior.
Assume documentation examples work with every compiler and EVM version.
Remove safeguards if they make a test more difficult.
Treat code that compiles as proof that it cannot fail.
questions.answer_key: Check the versioned official guidance, inspect compiler/test evidence, and document limitations before relying on the behavior.
questions.explanation: Compiler and network capabilities change, and a compiling example can still have logic or security defects. Versioned sources, reproducible tests, and honest limitations support a responsible review.
